verdicts.reason: A: the 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' eyebrow is blown up to near-headline size and crowds the right column. The RSVP button sits in the same row as the three pills, so the CTA is weakened. The broken missing-asset placeholder is large and clearly visible, the 'Reserve a spot' text and legal line are unreadably tiny, and the bottom-right is dead space. Even so, the left/right banner structure reads clearly. B is more broken: the subtitle and address are squeezed into a narrow middle column with 4–5-line ragged wraps, the eyebrow shrinks to illegible, the RSVP button is the same size as the 'Free Entry' pill, and the pills are scattered across two rows. 'Sessions' nearly touches the middle column, and the 'Reserve a spot' line competes with the CTA.
